definition: Hartmut Neven (born 1964) is a German American scientist and entrepreneur working in quantum computing, computer vision, robotics and computational neuroscience.
details: He is best known for his work in face and object recognition and his contributions to quantum machine learning. He is currently Vice President of Engineering at Google where he leads the Quantum Artificial Intelligence Lab, which he founded in 2012.

explainer.lead: Hartmut Neven is a German scientist. His work spans physics.

contributions.name: He wrote his Master thesis on a neuronal model of object recognition at the Max Planck Institute for Biological Cybernetics under Valentino Braitenberg.

timeline.what: Doctor of Natural Sciences, Ruhr University Bochum
In 1998 Neven became research professor of computer science at the University of Southern California at the Laboratory for Biological and Computational Vision.

affiliations: Max Planck Institute for Biological Cybernetics
